fields.label: Host
fields.name: host
fields.info: Host of the S3-compatible endpoint, without http:// (e.g. seaweedfs)

fields.label: Port
fields.name: port
fields.info: S3 port of the endpoint (e.g. 8333 for SeaweedFS, 9000 for MinIO)

fields.label: Access Key
fields.name: accessKey
fields.info: Access Key for the S3-compatible endpoint

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.name: secretKey
fields.info: Secret Key for the S3-compatible endpoint

fields.label: Prefix
fields.name: prefix
fields.info: Prefix of folder in the bucket

fields.label: Public Base URL
fields.name: publicBaseUrl
fields.info: Base of the links to the source objects (document.url); defaults to http://<host>:<port>

fields.label: Columns
fields.name: columns
fields.info: List of columns in case of extracting excel file

fields.label: Datasource Payload Key
fields.name: datasourcePayloadKey
fields.info: Key for data in datasource payload

fields.label: Additional Metadata
fields.name: additionalMetadata
fields.info: Map of additional metadata in datasource payload
